title: Value of a TRICARE Prime Installment Paid Ahead by One-Time Payment
content:
An installment that a one-time payment on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment pays ahead is valued like the installment the method on file last collected - the installment against which the latest payment collected through the enrollment's method on file stands - or, where the method on file has never collected, like the settled installment:

| Installment the method on file last collected (or, where it never collected, the settled installment) | Value of an installment paid ahead |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (divided by 12), rounded to the cent |
| a quarterly installment | one quarter of it (divided by 4), rounded to the cent |
| otherwise | the whole annual fee |

**Hypothetical.** An enrollment on a TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A individual arrangement (390.12) whose recurring card last collected a quarterly installment values each installment paid ahead at 97.53, even if its later installments are monthly.
